component.name: CineWindows
component.summary: Play local and streamed media with libmpv

description.p: CineWindows is a desktop media player built with Qt, QML, and libmpv. It supports hardware-accelerated playback, subtitles, playlists, streaming, video filters, screenshots, and a local companion remote.
Improves timeline preview speed and support for cookie and header-authenticated web streams.
Fixes QML type metadata generation for the embedded mpv player.
Fixes subtitle disabling and flushes saved playback positions before closing.
Improves grouped settings dividers, spacing, color pickers, and scrollbar gutters.
Adds saved YouTube quality preferences and a unified file, path, and URL picker.
Improves sliders, subtitle icons, startup reliability, thumbnail previews, diagnostic exports, and Linux desktop icons.
